description: Capability for the React SPA webview. Matches on `webviews` only (not `windows`) so the grant is narrowed to webviews literally labeled 'main' — any child webview added to the main window with a different label (e.g. the sniffer) doesn't inherit the broad core:default surface. Per Tauri 2 ACL semantics, `windows` and `webviews` match independently (OR), so listing `windows: ['main']` here would have broadened the grant to every webview inside the main window regardless of label. The Owner bearer is never exposed to JS in any webview: the host keeps it host-side and presents it on the SPA's direct-loopback API requests (loopback-provenance owner trust), so script never reads it. There is no host command that returns the bearer.
